input_authorities.input: live versus historical and causally ordered observation facts
validated source identity availability role anchors and versions
validated bounded untrusted hypotheses only; never transition authority
exact persistent field allowlist and retention
atomic encrypted record transaction and rollback boundary

record_contracts.ordering: closed enum order for sets; semantic role then opaque reference bytes for references; transition order by loop_version
record_contracts.version_rules: schema policy and loop versions are nonzero integers; loop_version increments exactly once per committed transition

record_contracts.source_ref_rule: required except for explicit user_supplied evidence; never accepts copied source text
record_contracts.timezone_rule: validated supported Windows or IANA identifier; normalized UTF-8; 1 through 128 bytes
record_contracts.value_rule: strict tagged temporal value matching precision; no generic string map JSON or extension member

record_contracts.user_action_rule: required for actor user and prohibited for actor system
record_contracts.source_ref_order: semantic relation code then opaque reference bytes; unique
record_contracts.facet_rule: complete prior and new facet tuples; no partial patch or generic map
record_contracts.text_rule: no copied rationale free text source phrase task person or generated explanation

legality_rules: resolution none if and only if obligation state is candidate or open; every terminal loop has exactly one non-none resolution
a system or model hypothesis can never produce terminal obligation state or a non-none resolution
possible kept_open and evidence_requested closure review states require an open obligation; candidate and terminal require closure review none
approaching and overdue require an open obligation plus a resolved operational boundary
candidate never ages and never authorizes a reminder write; terminal stops aging but retains deadline evidence and value
undated_confirmed requires an explicit user transition and has no operational boundary; it suppresses repeat prompts until causally later deadline evidence or user edit
quarantined requires an encrypted re-fetchable locator and retry or dismiss path before cursor advancement
changed unavailable or partially available source freezes evidence-dependent automation and never proves closure failure or dismissal
reminder completion deletion missing conflict or ambiguity never changes obligation state or resolution; candidate stays candidate open stays open and terminal stays terminal
later evidence on a terminal loop may add needs_review and a validated relation but never changes resolution reopens or sets closure review non-none
model confidence alone never promotes candidate to open
user correction dominates repeated automated input unless validated evidence is causally later

establishment_policy.case: validated explicit outgoing promise; medium or high; no core ambiguity
validated direct incoming request or question; deterministic identity; medium or high; no core ambiguity

establishment_policy.promise_rule: add promised only with supported future-act evidence

establishment_policy.case: validated explicit deterministic attribution; high; no transfer ambiguity
soft implied social contextual role low-confidence or core-ambiguous
user confirms candidate mine and actionable

deadline_policy.separation: requested promised inferred user-supplied operative and reminder deadlines remain distinct; reminder override never changes operative deadline
deadline_policy.default_eod: 17:00 user-local; changing timezone EOD week or date-only policy previews affected loops and requires confirmation before rewriting a confirmed boundary
operative_rules: same-message requested and user-promised deadlines are both retained and the promised deadline is operative unless actor or scope is ambiguous
a causally later confidently associated user extension becomes operative without requester acceptance and records renegotiated
a causally later confidently associated requester directive or counter becomes operative and preserves the prior extension
a date mention without directive or modification meaning never changes the operative deadline
independent actions split; ambiguous attachment preserves alternatives sets deadline_ambiguous and requires review
no deadline is an explicit user choice that sets undated_confirmed
unresolved event-relative evidence stays unresolved with deadline_ambiguous until one event is selected
soft urgency is scheduled without an aging boundary and never becomes approaching or overdue
aging_rules: instant ages against its evidence-derived instant
date and business_day age against a configured policy boundary without upgrading evidence precision
week ages against retained range end and displays the range
event_relative ages only after unique event correlation
soft unspecified and undated_confirmed never age
terminal and candidate do not newly age; open alone projects approaching or overdue
deadline_policy.defer_reminder_rule: records a user transition that suppresses the current prompt version only; it does not set undated_confirmed change evidence or authorize an artifact

hypothesis_projection.identity: target loop plus hypothesis kind plus ordered validated source references including source versions plus policy version
hypothesis_projection.persistence: represented only by approved source relations and transition reason/source/version fields; no new hypothesis text key or model rationale
projection_order: possible if any unsuppressed current hypothesis exists
evidence_requested if no possible hypothesis and any evidence request is pending
kept_open if no possible or requested hypothesis and at least one current hypothesis was suppressed
hypothesis_projection.suppression: keep_open suppresses only the exact identity; causally later source version or a different loop kind source tuple or policy version remains reviewable

command_policy.required: explicit user action and current loop version
command_policy.result: open with preserved provenance and appended transition

command_policy.required: one or more validated closure evidence refs and explicit user action
explicit decline evidence or manual decline confirmation
command_policy.result: terminal declined distinct from closed dismissed and moot
command_policy.external_effect: never send; optional detach or complete is separate

command_policy.required: withdrawal supersession no-longer-relevant evidence or explicit manual choice
delegation evidence or manual confirmation of full transfer
command_policy.result: terminal delegated only for transferred; shared assisted retained or unclear stays open

command_policy.required: exact current hypothesis identity and explicit user action
explicit user action and hypothesis kind
selected evidence old and target loop versions
command_policy.result: atomic relation detach and attach then deterministic re-evaluation of both loops
replace or add proposed relation and re-render without terminal change

command_policy.required: typed correction reason and explicit user action
command_policy.result: terminal dismissed except typed transferred or moot outcomes

command_policy.required: explicit user action and current loop version
command_policy.result: open resolution none closure review none needs_review added prior history retained and evidence re-evaluated

correction_policy.current_and_future: current-loop correction and durable future rule are separate commands and separate confirmations
correction_policy.future_rule: explicit settings or rule only; prospective by default; never model training personalization or hidden profile
correction_policy.replay: optional bounded review-only replay; never historical reminder mutation
correction_policy.duplicate: version-check survivor and loser; transfer only validated non-conflicting evidence and deadline history; append both transitions; loser becomes dismissed duplicate; conflicts remain reviewable

transition_policy.automated_key: validated source identity and source version plus policy version and target loop; replay is a no-op
user_key_algorithm: lookup opaque command key before version comparison
same key and same canonical payload returns original result with zero mutation
same key and different payload is command_key_collision
unseen key with stale expected loop version is visible_refresh_conflict
validate current state evidence and command preconditions
append exactly one transition and increment loop version atomically
transition_policy.reopen_generation: old command keys remain historical no-ops and cannot re-terminal a reopened generation
transition_policy.rollback: suspected rollback freezes all outward mutation; ADR-005 recovery and reconciliation remains authoritative

reminder_boundary.completion_or_deletion: changes reminder facet only; obligation and resolution are monotonic absent an explicit user lifecycle command
reminder_boundary.obligation_projection: candidate stays candidate open stays open and terminal stays terminal
reminder_boundary.terminal_transition: commits independently before any optional reminder operation; remote failure never rolls back the local lifecycle transition
reminder_boundary.proposal_revocation: candidate or terminal transition revokes local proposal authorization but never deletes or reconciles an extant artifact automatically
reminder_boundary.automatic_mutation: prohibited pending ADR-009 ADR-011 and applicable gates

prohibited_values: human-readable task person client subject body attachment link or deadline phrase
free-text reason rationale correction explanation or note
raw Microsoft Graph Office account tenant message event task or URL identifier
prompt model request response output rationale embedding transcript or vector
generic JSON map extension bag open enum unbounded string bytes array or blob
privacy_boundary.diagnostics: fixed non-content codes and bounded counters only; no facet history source identifier temporal value or command payload
privacy_boundary.persistence_runtime: disabled; ADR-005 G-STATE and G-PRIV remain required before accepting a logical record
